system.boundary: Build a causal, closed-loop articulated wheel-loader model that executes coordinated forward/reverse Y-cycle manoeuvres while lifting, tilting and steering a loaded bucket.
engineering_objects: The plant must include four driven wheels with ground contact, an articulated chassis, lift and tilt linkage dynamics, pressure-limited hydraulic pumps/valves/cylinders, an engine-driven power-split continuously variable transmission, physical clutch or mode dynamics, and hydraulic regenerative braking with an accumulator.
Vehicle motion, linkage load, hydraulic pressure/flow and powertrain energy flow must remain physically coupled.
